description.text: Training target: This major has the basic knowledge and basic ability in basic medicine, clinical medicine, medical examination and so on. It can be a senior specialist in medical laboratory and medical laboratory at all levels of hospital, blood station and epidemic prevention department. Students should master basic theory knowledge and experimental operation ability in basic medicine, clinical medicine, medical examination, experimental diagnosis and so on. At the same time, they should master the knowledge of natural science and Humanities and social sciences. After graduation, he can engage in clinical laboratory medicine, laboratory teaching and scientific research. Knowledge skills: Students should acquire the following knowledge and ability; 1. Basic theoretical knowledge and experimental skills in medical chemistry, medical physics and basic medicine; 2. Basic knowledge of clinical diagnosis of disease; 3. Basic theoretical knowledge and experimental operation skills of clinical medical examination; 4. Basic knowledge and skills of mathematical statistics and computer application; 5. The structure and operation skills of various commonly used medical analysis instruments; 6. Basic knowledge and skills related to health related tests; 7. Have the preliminary ability of clinical medical laboratory research. Major courses: Organic chemistry, inorganic chemistry, biochemistry, biochemistry, molecular biology, medical statistics, analytical chemistry, laboratory instrumentation, physiology, pathology, systemic anatomy, local anatomy, parasitology and test, microbiology and test, immunology and test, hematology test, clinical biochemistry, Test, clinical transfusion and test, clinical basic test, medical English, diagnostics, internal medicine, surgery, obstetrics and Gynecology, pediatrics, infectious diseases, pharmacology, computer basis and application. Intership: Including clinical practice, graduation practice, generally arranged for 48 weeks. Duration: 5 years

duration.text: The Medical Laboratory Science at Dalian Medical University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5555 USD/per year ￥ 40000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graducation Certificate of High school Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper

requirements.text: 1.Applicant should be between 18 and 25 2.Applicant should hold high school graduation or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate
